name: Aerospace Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Aerospace Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts, oil and gas equipment, and functional materials in China and internationally. It offers instrument panel assembly, sub-instrument and door panel assemblies, pillar inner guard plate, EPP foam parts, bumper assemblies, spoiler assemblies, all-plastic tailgate assemblies, underbody trims, ventilation cover assemblies, fenders, engine intake manifolds, pressure pipes, fuel rails, cylinder covers, molds for bumpers, pillars, door sills, intake manifolds, engine decorative covers, perforating equipment, completion equipment, and electromechanical control products.
